title: Yellow Syrian Herb Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic Syrian dish featuring a blend of herbs and fast action yeast, perfect for a crowd, this pilaf is a shojin-friendly option that is both herbal and pillowy in texture.

ingredients.name: mixed herbs
ingredients.notes: such as parsley, dill, and mint

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the mixed herbs, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the basmati rice and stir to combine with the herb mixture.
Add the water and lemon juice, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in the fast action yeast.
Let the pilaf rest, covered, for 5 minutes before serving.
